title: cyathea haenkei
intro: Cyathea haenkei, commonly known as the Haenke's tree fern, is a species of tree fern that belongs to the family Cyatheaceae. This plant is known to have several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe and protect the body. The therapeutic actions of Cyathea haenkei include wound healing, antimicrobial activity, and antipyretic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
